en.text: Model Y is now the best-selling car in the world. Not just EV — any car. The future is electric.
en.context: Announcing Model Y as world's best-selling car

zh.text: Model Y现在是世界上销量最好的汽车。不只是电动车——是所有汽车。未来是电动的。
zh.context: 宣布Model Y成为全球最畅销汽车

en.text: FSD Beta is now available to over 100K North American Tesla owners. The feedback loop is accelerating.

zh.text: FSD Beta现在已向超过10万名北美特斯拉车主开放。反馈循环正在加速。

en.text: Tesla delivered 1.3M vehicles in 2022. A new record. But we're just getting started.

zh.text: 特斯拉在2022年交付了130万辆汽车。新纪录。但我们才刚刚开始。

en.text: Gigafactory Texas is now producing 5000 Model Y per week. The ramp is incredible.

zh.text: Gigafactory德州工厂现在每周生产5000辆Model Y。产能爬坡令人难以置信。

en.text: Tesla's Master Plan Part 3 is out. It shows a path to a fully sustainable energy economy. No more fossil fuels.

zh.text: 特斯拉的Master Plan第三部分发布了。它展示了一条通往完全可持续能源经济的道路。不再需要化石燃料。

en.text: The Cybertruck is finally in production. It looks like it came from a different planet. Deliveries start Nov 30.
en.context: Announcing Cybertruck production and delivery date

zh.text: Cybertruck终于投产了。它看起来像是来自另一个星球。11月30日开始交付。

en.text: FSD has now driven over 1 billion miles autonomously. The neural net is getting smarter every day.

zh.text: FSD现在已经自主行驶超过10亿英里。神经网络每天都在变得更聪明。

en.text: First Cybertruck deliveries today! This is the most unique vehicle ever made. Stainless steel exoskeleton, bulletproof glass.

zh.text: 今天首批Cybertruck交付！这是有史以来最独特的车辆。不锈钢外骨骼，防弹玻璃。

en.text: Tesla delivered 1.81M vehicles in 2023. 38% growth year over year. The EV revolution is accelerating.

zh.text: 特斯拉在2023年交付了181万辆汽车。同比增长38%。电动车革命正在加速。

en.text: Gigafactory Berlin is now producing Model Y at full capacity. 375K vehicles per year from one factory.

zh.text: Gigafactory柏林工厂现在以满产能生产Model Y。一个工厂年产37.5万辆。

en.text: FSD v12 is here. It's end-to-end neural net. No more hand-coded rules. The car drives like a human — but better.

zh.text: FSD v12来了。它是端到端神经网络。不再有手工编码的规则。车开得像人——但更好。

en.text: Tesla's Shanghai Gigafactory has produced over 2 million vehicles total. China is our biggest market.

zh.text: 特斯拉上海超级工厂总产量已超过200万辆。中国是我们最大的市场。
zh.context: 上海工厂累计产量里程碑

en.text: Announcing the Tesla Robotaxi. Unveiling October 2024. No steering wheel. No pedals. Just ride.

zh.text: 宣布特斯拉Robotaxi。2024年10月揭幕。没有方向盘。没有踏板。只需乘坐。

en.text: The Tesla Robotaxi is here. It's beautiful, it's autonomous, and it will change transportation forever.

zh.text: 特斯拉Robotaxi来了。它很美，它是自动驾驶的，它将永远改变交通。

en.text: Robotaxi testing will begin in Austin, Texas in 2025 with a small fleet. Full deployment by 2026.

zh.text: Robotaxi测试将于2025年在德克萨斯州奥斯汀以小规模车队开始。2026年全面部署。

en.text: Tesla delivered 1.8M vehicles in 2024. Despite global headwinds, we grew. The mission continues.

zh.text: 特斯拉在2024年交付了180万辆汽车。尽管全球逆风，我们仍在增长。使命继续。

en.text: FSD has now accumulated over 3 billion autonomous miles. The data flywheel is spinning faster than ever.

zh.text: FSD现在累计超过30亿英里的自主行驶里程。数据飞轮转得比以往更快。

en.text: Robotaxi testing has begun in Austin! The first autonomous rides are happening right now. This is the future.

zh.text: Robotaxi测试已在奥斯汀开始！第一批自动驾驶乘车正在发生。这就是未来。

en.text: The new Model 3 Highland is the best car we've ever made. Incredible efficiency, beautiful design, and it's affordable.

zh.text: 新款Model 3 Highland是我们造过的最好的车。令人难以置信的效率，美丽的设计，而且价格亲民。

en.text: Tesla's Robotaxi fleet in Austin has completed 50,000 autonomous rides. Zero accidents. The safety record is flawless.

zh.text: 特斯拉在奥斯汀的Robotaxi车队已完成5万次自动驾驶乘车。零事故。安全记录完美无瑕。

en.text: Robotaxi is expanding to 10 more US cities in 2025. San Francisco, LA, Chicago, Miami, and more.

zh.text: Robotaxi将在2025年扩展到美国10个更多城市。旧金山、洛杉矶、芝加哥、迈阿密等。

en.text: Gigafactory Mexico is under construction. It will produce the next-gen affordable Tesla. $25K car is real.
en.context: Mexico factory construction and affordable car plans

zh.text: Gigafactory墨西哥工厂正在建设中。它将生产下一代平价特斯拉。2.5万美元的车是真的。
zh.context: 墨西哥工厂建设和平价车型计划

en.text: Robotaxi nationwide rollout begins 2026. If you're in the US, you'll be able to hail a Tesla robotaxi anywhere.

zh.text: Robotaxi全国推广将于2026年开始。如果你在美国，你可以在任何地方叫一辆特斯拉robotaxi。

en.text: FSD v14 is the biggest leap yet. It handles complex urban environments better than most human drivers.

zh.text: FSD v14是迄今为止最大的飞跃。它处理复杂城市环境的能力比大多数人类驾驶员更好。

en.text: Tesla's energy storage deployments hit 50 GWh in 2025. We're the biggest battery company in the world.

zh.text: 特斯拉2025年储能部署达到50 GWh。我们是世界上最大的电池公司。
zh.context: 特斯拉储能部署里程碑

en.text: The Cybertruck has been a massive hit. Over 500K delivered. It's the most unique vehicle on the road.

zh.text: Cybertruck大获成功。已交付超过50万辆。它是路上最独特的车辆。

en.text: Tesla Supercharger network now has 60,000 stalls worldwide. The infrastructure for the EV revolution is in place.

zh.text: 特斯拉超级充电网络现在全球有6万个充电桩。电动车革命的基础设施已经就位。
zh.context: 超级充电网络规模里程碑

en.text: Tesla delivered 2.1M vehicles in 2025. A new all-time record. The EV transition is unstoppable.

zh.text: 特斯拉在2025年交付了210万辆汽车。新的历史纪录。电动车转型不可阻挡。

en.text: Robotaxi is now operating in 15 US cities. 200,000 autonomous rides completed. The future of transport is here.

zh.text: Robotaxi现在在15个美国城市运营。已完成20万次自动驾驶乘车。交通的未来已来。

en.text: The new Model S Plaid does 0-60 in 1.9 seconds. It's the fastest production car ever made. Period.

zh.text: 新款Model S Plaid百公里加速1.9秒。它是有史以来最快的量产车。句号。

en.text: Robotaxi nationwide launch: June 2026. Every American city. This will be bigger than Uber and Lyft combined.

zh.text: Robotaxi全国上线：2026年6月。每个美国城市。这将比Uber和Lyft加起来还大。

en.text: Tesla's FSD has driven 10 billion autonomous miles. That's more than all other self-driving companies combined times 100.

zh.text: 特斯拉FSD已自主行驶100亿英里。这比所有其他自动驾驶公司加起来的100倍还多。
zh.context: FSD累计行驶里程重大里程碑

en.text: The sustainable energy future is not a dream. It's happening. Tesla is leading the charge — literally.

zh.text: 可持续能源未来不是梦想。它正在发生。特斯拉正在引领这场变革——字面意义上的。
zh.context: 关于可持续能源使命的评论

en.text: Gigafactory Mexico first vehicles rolling off the line. The $25K Tesla era begins.

zh.text: Gigafactory墨西哥工厂首批车辆下线。2.5万美元特斯拉时代开始。

en.text: Tesla's vertical integration is our biggest advantage. We make our own motors, batteries, and software.
en.context: Commentary on Tesla's vertical integration strategy

zh.text: 特斯拉的垂直整合是我们最大的优势。我们制造自己的电机、电池和软件。
zh.context: 关于特斯拉垂直整合战略的评论

en.text: The Model Y Juniper refresh is coming. New interior, better efficiency, longer range. Best gets better.

zh.text: Model Y Juniper改款即将到来。新内饰，更高效率，更长续航。最好的变得更好。

en.text: Tesla's cost per vehicle has dropped 30% in 2 years through manufacturing innovation. Savings passed to customers.

zh.text: 特斯拉通过制造创新在2年内将单车成本降低了30%。节省的成本传递给了客户。
zh.context: 关于制造成本降低的评论

en.text: Tesla Optimus robots are now working in our factories. The future of manufacturing is here.

zh.text: 特斯拉Optimus机器人现在在我们的工厂工作。制造的未来已来。

en.text: Tesla's global Supercharger network is now open to all EVs. We're accelerating the entire industry's transition.
en.context: Supercharger network opened to all EVs

zh.text: 特斯拉全球超级充电网络现在向所有电动车开放。我们正在加速整个行业的转型。
zh.context: 超级充电网络向所有电动车开放

en.text: Tesla has produced over 10 million vehicles total. From 0 to 10M in under 20 years. The EV revolution is real.

zh.text: 特斯拉总产量已超过1000万辆。不到20年从0到1000万。电动车革命是真实的。
zh.context: 特斯拉累计产量1000万辆里程碑
